name: internet-archive-mcp-server
description: Search the Wayback Machine and IA library (40M+ items), fetch archived snapshots, retrieve item metadata and full text via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search the Wayback Machine and IA library (40M+ items), fetch archived snapshots, retrieve item metadata and full text via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: MCP server for the Internet Archive and the Wayback Machine. Five read-only tools — ia_find_snapshots (Availability/CDX lookup), ia_get_snapshot (archived page text), ia_search_items (Solr library search), ia_get_item (full metadata + file manifest), and ia_get_text (paginated book/document text) — plus an ia://item/{identifier} metadata resource. No credentials required; runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
